fieldNotes.facility: Confirmed via Street View — Frito-Lay logo visible on the office building (sv19, 2023-07 capture). Large multi-building manufacturing campus at 298 Industrial Blvd, Pulaski TN. Geocoded coords accurate.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole campus is enclosed by black metal/chain-link fence (confirmed in 5+ Street Views). Trucks reach the active dock yards and the NW drop yard via internal driveways from the public road; the drop-yard entrance is a fenced, controlled opening. Treated as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No classic 1-3-vehicle guard booth visible at a public-road gate. A small angled-roof structure sits at the drop-yard entrance and may serve as a transportation/check-in office, but it could not be positively confirmed as a staffed guard shack — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true given a controlled truck entrance with no confirmed guard booth — implies kiosk/app/office check-in. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated drop yard on the NW side — two long rows of carrier trailers (orange/white, ~40-55 trailers) plus box trucks, chain-link fenced, served by a rail spur. Capacity ~70.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed — a rail spur crosses the west access road and runs into the property alongside the drop yard and dock buildings (sv13, dropyard satellite).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~45 across the rail-served dock building, the warehouse SW/west edge, and a sawtooth dock building. Multiple separate dock banks on different building faces → shipRcvSeparate true. Count is an honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has 6+ distinct buildings — main process plant, large finished-goods warehouse, sawtooth dock building, rail dock building, office, and the drop-yard transportation building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting in Pulaski TN, surrounded by woods and open fields — Rural.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal driveways from public road to docks are long with ample room to stack 3+ trucks.
